battle.name: 伊吾廬之戰
battle.theater: 天山北麓伊吾廬至稽落山
battle.brief: 永平十六年（73年）春，車師後部與北匈奴單于車利鹿王合兵圍伊吾廬，殺西域長史陳睦。漢明帝詔竇固、耿秉出酒泉，分道越玉門，會師天山稽落山，大破北匈奴，斬首千餘級，單于西走。卡面秦連弩承秦代弩機工藝，漢軍沿用其制：屯田與守城部隊以連發弩壓住來犯騎兵，出征主力則以弩陣配合騎兵迂迴取勝。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 伊吾廬之戰是東漢與北匈奴在塔里木盆地東端、天山北麓伊吾廬一帶爆發的一場邊境戰爭，交戰年份為公元73年，東漢明帝永平十六年。東漢一方是中央直轄的河西邊軍：主帥竇固以征西將軍之號統軍，副將耿秉時任駃騎將軍，兩人各領兵馬自酒泉出發，隨軍有敦煌、酒泉兩郡的邊兵，以及護送給養的車駕與駱駝；西域方面則是設於柳中城的西域長史府，長史陳睦領兵屯駐並管轄車師前部等屬國，更有西域都護府留在烏壘城的舊制與更西邊的西域諸國按例提供的助兵與糧食。漢廷的指揮鏈條是：明帝下詔、兵曹承制、將軍自行分道、沿途候官與烽燧接力傳報，西域長史與屬國則負責供給向导、引路與柴水。北匈奴一方是冒頓以來北支的單于庭，單于車利鹿王親率精騎主力，控有天山北坡與蒲類海周邊的草場，並以車師後部作為進逼漢朝邊塞的跳板；北匈奴軍以騎兵為骨幹，輔以弓矢游騎與少量步卒，沒有大型攻城器械，也沒有成型的攻城技術，卻掌握主動出擊的節奏權。第三方是塔里木盆地東部的車師國，其前部附漢、後部叛漢，後部王與北匈奴合流，成為漢軍縱深中的破口。這場戰爭因此不是單純的邊塞摩擦，而是漢朝在西域東段設置的屯田—都護—屬國體系，與北匈奴在塔里木東端爭奪控制權的一次正面交鋒。
countriesEn: The Battle of Yiwulu was a frontier war between the Eastern Han and the Northern Xiongnu fought around Yiwulu at the northern foot of the Tian Shan, at the eastern end of the Tarim basin, in 73 CE, the sixteenth year of the Yongping reign of Emperor Ming of Han. The Han side was the frontier army of the Hexi Corridor, directly commanded from the centre: the commander-in-chief Dou Gu held the title of General Who Conquers the West, his colleague Geng Bing was General of the Swift Cavalry, and each led a body of troops out of Jiuquan, with the frontier soldiers of the commanderies of Dunhuang and Jiuquan and the carts and camels carrying their provisions behind them; on the western side stood the Office of the Chief of the Western Regions at Liuzhong city, where Chief of the Western Regions Chen Mu held troops and supervised dependent states such as the northern branch of Jushi, together with the older establishment of the Protectorate left at Wulei and the contingents and grain that the states further west supplied as was their custom. The Han chain of command ran from an imperial edict, through the ministry that drafted the orders, to generals who divided their forces as they judged fit, with the watch posts and beacon towers of the frontier passing reports onward and the Chief of the Western Regions and the dependent states providing guides, firewood and water. The Northern Xiongnu side was the northern branch of the Chanyu court descended from Modu: the Chanyu Chelilu Wang led the main body of his picked cavalry in person, held the pastures on the northern slopes of the Tian Shan and around Lake Barkol, and used the southern branch of Jushi as a springboard from which to press against the Han frontier; the army was built on cavalry, supported by mounted skirmishers shooting arrows and by a small number of foot, and it had neither heavy siege engines nor any settled technique for storming walls, yet it held the initiative on the timing of the attack. The third party was the kingdom of Jushi in the eastern Tarim basin, whose northern branch submitted to the Han while the southern branch revolted, the king of the southern branch joining the Northern Xiongnu and becoming a breach in the Han rear. The war was therefore not a local border incident but a direct trial of strength between the Han system of garrison colonies, protectorate and dependent states in the eastern western regions and the Northern Xiongnu for control of the eastern end of the Tarim.
people: 改變這場戰爭走向的是明帝劉莊。永平十六年北匈奴犯邊、西域長史陳睦戰歿的消息傳到雒陽，廷議很快由守轉攻：詔令竇固、耿秉出酒泉討北匈奴，並許以便宜追擊之權；然而當竇固請益兵深入、追北匈奴單于於天山之北時，朝廷又以軍糧不繼、天寒馬疲為由下詔班師，止住追擊的腳步。這一收一放，是本役最具決定性的兩個動作。主帥竇固出身扶風竇氏，為大將軍竇融之孫，早年即在關中與羌地任職，熟稔河西山川與部族分布，漢廷正是憑他對天山北麓道路的熟悉，選定在巴倫湖一線設伏出擊；他在稽落山一戰中策騎兵分兩翼包抄，又屢次上疏力主追擊，志在把北匈奴一舉趕出蒲類海。副將耿秉出自扶風耿氏，相傳其父耿夔為東漢初年名將，同樣主張乘勝追北，原議由他直抵車師故地，兩人合計出動騎兵數千，兵分兩路，會於天山。陣亡的西域長史陳睦是此役另一位關鍵人物：永平十五年漢廷剛在西域設置長史府、駐兵柳中，他上任未及一年便在伊吾廬與車師後王的衝突中殉職，他的死直接把一場邊塞衝突升級為中央出兵的理由。北匈奴單于車利鹿王是敵方唯一的決策者，他選擇在漢朝屯田城伊吾廬與車師後部之間撕開缺口，戰敗後率眾西走，兩年後再率部眾西遷。班超此時尚在疏勒，其後被任為西域都護，接手殘局。也有史家把竇固請兵與朝廷不許追擊之間的落差，歸因於永平以來以休養為主的邊防國策。
peopleEn: The decision that shaped this war was Emperor Ming of Han's, Liu Zhuang. When the news of the Northern Xiongnu incursion and of the death of the Chief of the Western Regions Chen Mu reached Luoyang, the debate at court turned at once from defence to attack: an edict sent Dou Gu and Geng Bing out of Jiuquan against the Northern Xiongnu and left them free to pursue in their own discretion; yet when Dou Gu asked for more men to drive the Chanyu north of the Tian Shan, the court stopped the pursuit where it stood, ordering the army home because the grain would not carry it and the season had turned cold with the horses exhausted. That giving and then taking away was the two decisive acts of the campaign. Dou Gu, the commander-in-chief, came from the Fu Feng Dou clan of the capital region as the grandson of the Great General Dou Rong, and had held posts early in his career in Guanzhong and among the Qiang, so he knew the rivers, roads and tribal geography of Hexi; the court chose him precisely for his familiarity with the roads north of the Tian Shan, and it was on ground he picked out around Lake Barkol that the Han struck. At the battle of Jiluoshan he sent cavalry round both wings to cut in, and he petitioned more than once for the pursuit to continue, determined to drive the Northern Xiongnu out of the Barkol basin altogether. His colleague Geng Bing, of the Fu Feng Geng clan, whose father Geng Ke is recorded as a general of the early Eastern Han, held the same view about pressing the advantage, and was to have taken the force assigned to him toward the old lands of Jushi; between them they took several thousand cavalry into the field in two columns and met at the Tian Shan. The other key figure was Chen Mu, the Chief of the Western Regions, who was killed in this war: the court had only set up his office and garrisoned Liuzhong in the year before, and he was dead within a year of taking it, cut down in the fighting at Yiwulu against the king of southern Jushi, and his death was what turned a border incident into a central cause for war. Chelilu Wang, the Chanyu of the Northern Xiongnu, was the only decision-maker on the enemy side: he chose to tear open the gap between the Han garrison town of Yiwulu and southern Jushi, and after his defeat he led his people west, migrating the whole of his host two years later. Ban Chao was at that moment still in Shule, and was afterwards appointed Protector of the Western Regions to take over the aftermath. Some historians read the gap between Dou Gu's request for more troops and the court's refusal to allow the pursuit as the product of the settled policy of resting the frontier that had been followed since the Yongping era.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩是弩機工藝的早期形態：把弦上好之後踏板下壓，槓杆把儲存的拉力一次又一次送入弩弦，扳機一按，弩矢即發，一台弩機可以連續射出十數支矢，不必每射一矢再重新上弦。《墨子》守城諸篇所記的連弩、轉射之類，講的正是把這種壓力儲備與快速放機的組合搬到城頭；秦人用它守城，漢承秦制，漢代邊軍的弩器中既有需要數十人合力張弦的擘張弩，也有一人踏弦的蹶張弩，弩機、矢、檄、機脛都有專門的配給與登記制度，出土的敦煌、居延簡牘中還能見到弩機部件與剩餘弩矢的記錄。就本役而言，連發弩機最適合的位置不是平原上的騎兵對決，而是伊吾廬、蒲類、柳中這幾處城與屯田點：它可以把箭幕壓在接近的騎兵與攻梯之間，使對方在牆下滯留，不得不成隊進攻。漢軍出征主力是騎兵，配備環首刀、長戟、大盾與角弓，弩手以強弩分列兩翼與前鋒之前，先以矢陣封住坡地，再由騎兵迂迴包抄；攻城與野營則用雲梯、飛樓、撞車一類器械，以及壕塹、鹿角、拒馬構成的障礙，並靠井車在流沙地帶取水。匈奴一方的裝備以複合弓與骨鏃、石鏃、鳴鏑為主，配短刀、標槍，皮甲革胄輕便，帳幕、弓囊與骨飾馬具隨行，馬群與橐駝群是他們在戈壁裡保持機動與給養的依靠；刀劍雖有鐵製品，卻不見大型攻城器械。真正左右戰局的是弩與馬的組合：漢軍以弩手的固定火力換取騎兵的機動打擊，匈奴以騎兵的速度換取繞射與衝鋒，最終在馬力與箭矢存量上分出勝負。
kitsEn: The Qin repeating crossbow on the card is an early form of the crossbow mechanism: the string is drawn and latched, a treadle is pressed down, and a lever delivers the stored tension into the string again and again, so that a single mechanism throws bolt after bolt without the shooter having to lace the bow afresh after every shot. The repeating crossbows and revolving arrow-slots described in the siege chapters of Mozi are this combination of stored pressure and quick release brought up onto a city wall; the Qin used them to defend walls, and the Han inherited the Qin's crossbow system, so that the Han frontier arsenal held both the large tension bows that needed scores of men to draw and the treadle-laced crossbows that one man could load, with mechanisms, bolts, tally-sticks and trigger-fittings all issued and registered under their own regulations, and excavated tablets from Dunhuang and Juyan still carry entries for crossbow parts and for bolts left over. For this campaign the repeating mechanism belonged in one place and not another: not in a plain cavalry duel on the steppe, but at the garrison towns and colonies of Yiwulu, Pulei and Liuzhong, where it could hold a curtain of arrows over the approaching horsemen and the scaling ladders and keep the enemy from standing beneath the walls in anything but closed formation. The Han striking force was cavalry, armed with ring-pommel sabres, long spears, large shields and composite bows, with strong crossbowmen drawn up in the wings and ahead of the vanguard, laying down a sheet of bolts across the slope first and then sending cavalry round and behind; for the assault and for the night camp they had scaling ladders, flying towers and battering rams, with the obstructions of trenches, spiked barriers and cheval-de-frise, and they drew water in the sand country with well-carts. The Xiongnu equipped themselves principally with composite bows, bone and stone points and whistling arrows, with short sabres, javelins and light leather armour, their tentage, bow cases and bone-decorated harness travelling with them, and they relied on their herds of horses and camels to keep moving and fed in the Gobi; their iron blades were few and they had no heavy siege engines at all. What actually decided the field was the combination of bow and horse: the Han traded the fixed fire of the crossbowmen for the mobility of their cavalry, while the Xiongnu traded the speed of their riders for encirclement shooting and charges, and in the end the contest was settled by horseflesh and by how many bolts each side had left.
tactics: 漢軍的出擊走的是敦煌與酒泉一線的邊塞通道：自酒泉起程，越過玉門，進入白龍堆一帶的流沙與鹽澤，隊伍以縱隊前推，騎兵擔任前導與偵察，弩手與步兵居中，橐駝、騾、馬匹馱載糧水與器械，營帳與工匠夾在隊中，沿途依托既有的烽燧與候官接應，井車就地取水以維持人馬的續航能力。竇固與耿秉分道：一路經蒲類海北岸，另一路取道車師故地，約定在天山北麓的稽落山一帶會合；北匈奴的游騎先期偵知漢軍動向，於是集結精騎在山北迎擊。接戰時漢軍倚地形列陣，弩手與長戟手在前張成一道封住坡地的火線，把衝鋒的匈奴騎兵擋在射界之內，騎兵則分兩翼繞出山脊與溝谷，從側後插入其密集隊形，一戰而散其鋒，斬首千餘級，追至蒲類海一線。追擊最終止步於後勤：愈往西深入水源愈少、戰馬乏食，天氣轉寒，漢廷詔令班師，竇固請益兵再進未獲准許，兵鋒就此收住。匈奴的戰法是內應配合外兵：車師後部以漢朝屬國的身分打開缺口，單于庭的騎兵則以高速掠奪漢軍糧道與驛傳為要，待漢軍主力逼近才傾巢出騎；戰敗之後退往天山西段與蒲類海北岸，收拾部眾再圖東進。漢軍在攻與守之間的取捨也很清楚：本役並未強攻城邑，而是以野戰解決戰鬥；戰後加固伊吾廬城防，設屯田、置守將，把戰場變成據點。
tacticsEn: The Han marched out along the frontier road that ran through Dunhuang and Jiuquan: setting out from Jiuquan, passing beyond Yumen and entering the sands and salt flats around the White Dragon Mound, the column advanced in order, with cavalry as advance scouts, crossbowmen and foot in the middle, and camels, mules and horses carrying grain, water and equipment, the camp tents and the craftsmen travelling inside the column, leaning on the beacon towers and watch posts already established along the route and using well-carts to draw water on the spot so that men and horses could keep moving. Dou Gu and Geng Bing took separate roads, one along the north shore of Lake Barkol and the other by the old country of Jushi, with a plan to meet in the neighbourhood of Jiluoshan on the northern slopes of the Tian Shan; the Xiongnu outriders detected the Han movement early, gathered their picked cavalry and offered battle to the north of the hills. In the fighting the Han took up the ground in line, crossbowmen and halberdiers in front to hold a curtain of fire across the slope and check the charging horsemen, while the cavalry worked round both flanks over the ridges and gullies and struck the dense enemy formation from the side and rear, breaking it in one stroke, cutting off more than a thousand heads and pressing the pursuit as far as the shores of Barkol. The pursuit finally stopped on logistics: the further west they went the fewer were the wells and the harder the horses fed, the weather turned cold, and the court ordered the army home, so Dou Gu's request for more men to continue was refused and the advance stopped where it was. The Xiongnu method was an internal accomplice working with an external army: the king of southern Jushi, wearing the clothes of a Han dependent state, opened the breach, and the Chanyu's riders made it their business to cut the Han supply line and the relay posts, bringing out the whole of their cavalry only when the main Han force closed; after the defeat they withdrew towards the western Tian Shan and the north shore of Barkol, gathered their people and looked for another road east. The Han were equally clear in their choice between assault and defence: the campaign was decided in the field and not against walls, and what followed the fighting was the reinforcement of Yiwulu's defences, the establishment of garrison colonies and the posting of commanders, so that the battlefield itself became a base.
data: 可依據的數字大致如下。交戰時間為公元73年，即東漢明帝永平十六年，出兵在春，月份或繫二月或繫三月，諸史所載不一；戰罷兵約在夏初，全役前後不足三個月。漢軍兵員方面，竇固、耿秉各將數千騎出酒泉，抄本所載有各領四千與竇固領四千、耿秉領二千兩說，合計約六千至八千騎，另有西域諸國按例提供的助兵，以及數千匹駱駝與馬匹輸送糧水。戰果方面，稽落山一戰《後漢書》系為斬首千餘級，並記漢軍追擊至蒲類海一線。路程上，自酒泉至巴倫湖與稽落山直線約一千四百餘里，漢軍實地行程更遠，且多在流沙與鹽澤之間取水，靠井車維持。善後的時間點是可以確定的：74年即永平十七年，漢廷置蒲類侯於宍街，車師故地重設屯田；75年即永平十八年，北匈奴單于車利鹿王率眾西遷，漢廷重設西域都護，以班超任之；89年即永元元年，竇固、耿秉、吳棠分道出擊，在稽落山與然亂山再破北匈奴，追至私渠比鞮海，斬獲數萬，竇固登燕然山刻石勒功。降附與西遷的北匈奴部眾，先後以數萬口至十餘萬口計，各書記載不一。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The fighting took place in 73 CE, the sixteenth year of Yongping under Emperor Ming of Han; the army set out in the spring, in the second or the third month according to the different texts, and the campaign was over by the beginning of summer, so that the whole business took less than three months. As to the Han force, Dou Gu and Geng Bing each took several thousand cavalry out of Jiuquan; the surviving copies give four thousand each on one hand and four thousand under Dou Gu with two thousand under Geng Bing on the other, so that the total lay in the region of six to eight thousand cavalry, with the contingents of the western states and several thousand camels and horses for grain and water. As to the result, the Hou Hanshu gives more than a thousand heads cut off at Jiluoshan and records the pursuit as far as the shores of Barkol. As to distance, the direct line from Jiuquan to Lake Barkol and Jiluoshan is rather more than fourteen hundred li, and the route actually walked was longer, much of it through sand and salt flats where the well-carts kept the column alive. The dates of the aftermath are firm: in 74, the seventeenth year of Yongping, the court established the Marquis of Pulei at Jiewei and restored the garrison colonies in the old country of Jushi; in 75, the eighteenth year, the Chanyu Chelilu Wang led his people west, and the court re-established the Protectorate of the Western Regions with Ban Chao in charge; in 89, the first year of Yongyuan, Dou Gu, Geng Bing and Wu Tang attacked by several routes, beat the Northern Xiongnu again at Jiluoshan and at Ranluan Hill, pursued them to the Lake of Siqubidi, took tens of thousands, and Dou Gu climbed the Yanran mountains to carve the record in stone. The Northern Xiongnu who came over or moved west are counted at various times in the tens of thousands and in the hundred thousands, and the books differ.
cause: 直接起因是車師後部的反叛與北匈奴的內應。永平十五年漢廷在西域設置西域長史府，屯兵柳中，企圖把東漢自前60年以來中斷的西域經營重新接上，車師正是這套體系東端的要地。車師後部王不願受漢廷約束，藉北匈奴單于車利鹿王之兵，圍攻漢朝在伊吾廬的屯田城，殺死上任未久的西域長史陳睦，斷絕漢使往來西域的道路，漢廷在塔里木東端的屏障一時被撕開。往深一層看，這場戰爭是匈奴分裂之後北方草原與西域爭奪的必然產物。匈奴自公元1世紀起分為南北兩部，南匈奴內附漢朝，北匈奴則節節西遷，佔據天山北麓與車師，控制塔里木盆地北道東段；漢朝若守不住伊吾廬與車師，商旅與使節的通道就會再次中斷，車師的良馬與屯田所出的糧食也無以為繼，匈奴與羌人若再合流，河西邊郡將首當其衝。漢廷自身也另有推力：明帝即位後沿用休養邊防的國策數年，到永平十六年已具備出兵的準備，竇固等河西宿將熟悉地形，敦煌與酒泉的屯田、烽燧與積粟可以支撐一次有限度的深入出擊，而西域都護府與屬國的合法存在本身，也需要一場戰爭來證明它不是一紙空文。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the revolt of southern Jushi and the collusion of the Northern Xiongnu. In the fifteenth year of Yongping the court set up the Office of the Chief of the Western Regions at Liuzhong, trying to pick up again the management of the western regions that had been interrupted since 60 BC, and Jushi was the hinge of that system at its eastern end. The king of southern Jushi was unwilling to stay under Han control, and taking the troops of the Chanyu Chelilu Wang he surrounded the Han garrison colony at Yiwulu and killed Chen Mu, the Chief of the Western Regions who had taken office only recently; the road by which Han envoys travelled west into the western regions was cut, and the screen the Han held at the eastern end of the Tarim was torn open at a stroke. At a deeper level the war was the necessary product of the struggle between the northern steppe and the western regions that followed the division of the Xiongnu. From the first century CE the Xiongnu split into a southern and a northern branch; the southern submitted to the Han, while the northern moved steadily west, occupied the northern foot of the Tian Shan and Jushi, and held the eastern stretch of the northern road of the Tarim basin. If the Han could not hold Yiwulu and Jushi, the passage of merchants and envoys would be cut again, the good horses of the west and the grain of the colonies would no longer come, and if the Xiongnu joined hands with the Qiang once more the commanderies of Hexi would be the first to bear it. The Han court had a push of its own: the reign of Emperor Ming had followed a policy of resting the frontier for several years, but by the sixteenth year of Yongping the means of a limited expedition were in place, the old frontier commanders such as Dou Gu knew the ground, and the colonies, beacons and stored grain of Dunhuang and Jiuquan could support a limited thrust, while the very existence of the Protectorate and of the dependent states needed a war to prove that it was not an empty paper.
impact: 伊吾廬之戰之後，漢朝在西域東端的處境明顯好轉。車師與伊吾廬兩地保住，兩年後漢廷在蒲類設侯、在交河恢復屯田，把天山東段重新釘進自己的版圖；75年重設西域都護府、班超以三十六人西行而終不辱命，說明漢廷有能力在西域維持一套以都護、都尉、屯田與屬國為骨架的治理結構。絲路東段的安全因此重現，敦煌至車師的商旅與使節往來恢復，漢朝從西域取得的良馬與物資供應重新暢通，這條線在後來兩百年裡一直是漢朝西域經營的骨干，張騞開路以來累積的通道利益，終於在這場戰爭之後重新接上。對北匈奴而言，這是一次戰略失敗帶來的戰略收縮：車利鹿王西遷後，北匈奴在天山以東的據點與部眾大批流失，草原權力重心西移，匈奴南北分裂的局面從此加速，兩漢之際的匈奴問題由南北並立逐漸轉為北逐西遷、南附漢廷，89年的燕然山刻石與其後的北匈奴崩解，源頭都在天山東端這幾年的拉鋸。戰術層面的啟示同樣具體：弩兵與騎兵結合、屬國內應與外兵配合，以及以有限兵力作有限目標出擊的邊疆作戰方式，在本役都得到驗證；而糧運與馬力的限制同樣清楚，它們提醒漢廷，任何深入天山北麓的軍事行動都必須先解決水與草。涼州羌事其後長期倚重羌兵與以羌攻羌之策，也正是同一個後勤邏輯的延伸。
impactEn: After the war the Han position in the eastern western regions visibly improved. Jushi and Yiwulu were held, and two years later the court set up the Marquis of Pulei and restored the garrison colony at Jiaohe, pinning the eastern end of the Tian Shan back into its own map; the re-establishment of the Protectorate in 75 and Ban Chao's westward journey with only thirty-six men to found it showed that the Han could maintain in the western regions a structure built on the protectorate, the commandants, the garrison colonies and the dependent states. Security on the eastern stretch of the Silk Road returned, merchants and envoys moved again between Dunhuang and Jushi, and the supply of good horses and goods from the west flowed once more; that line remained the backbone of Han policy in the west for the next two hundred years, and the interests of the corridor accumulated since Zhang Qian's opening of the road were at last connected again. For the Northern Xiongnu this was a strategic contraction following a tactical defeat: after Chelilu Wang moved west, the Xiongnu lost their footholds and their people in bulk east of the Tian Shan, the centre of steppe power shifted westward, and the division of the Xiongnu accelerated, the problem of the Xiongnu in the two Han periods moving from a balance of north and south towards the north being driven west and the south attached to the Han; the carving of the Yanran mountains in 89 and the later break-up of the Northern Xiongnu both had their origin in these years of pulling and hauling at the eastern end of the Tian Shan. The tactical lessons were just as concrete: crossbows combined with cavalry, an internal accomplice combined with an external army, and the border-war method of committing limited forces to limited objectives were all tested in this campaign; and the constraints of supply and horseflesh were just as clear, warning the court that any military move north of the Tian Shan had to settle the question of water and grass first. The long reliance of the Liangzhou administration on Qiang troops and on using the Qiang against the Qiang was an extension of the same logic of logistics.
result: 就73年這一役本身而言，結果是清楚的：漢軍在稽落山擊破北匈奴，斬首千餘級，車利鹿王引眾西走，伊吾廬與車師的危機解除；但竇固請益兵再追的請求沒有得到批准，詔以糧餉不繼、馬疲天寒罷兵，因此這是一場戰術上的勝利，而不是戰略上的全勝，北匈奴的實力並未在這一年被消滅。真正的收官要再等三年：75年車利鹿王率眾西遷，漢廷於是重設西域都護，伊吾廬至車師、柳中、蒲類一線的屯田與侯官體系落實，73年那場戰爭定下的目標才算完成；89年永元元年，竇固、耿秉、吳棠分道出擊，在稽落山與然亂山兩度大破北匈奴，追至私渠比鞮海，竇固登燕然山刻石，才算把北匈奴的崩解寫成了文字。回頭看本役，它有兩條清楚的邏輯：漢廷以有限度的出擊換取西域東端的安全與通道，用兵精而不濫；匈奴以屬國內應與騎兵機動拖住漢廷，卻在正面消耗戰中輸掉雙方的續航能力，最終只能西走。戰場上真正決定勝負的是弩陣與騎兵的配合、內應與外兵的夾擊，以及水與草這兩件最不浪漫的東西。
resultEn: For the year 73 itself the outcome is plain: the Han beat the Northern Xiongnu at Jiluoshan, cut off more than a thousand heads, Chelilu Wang led his people west, and the danger to Yiwulu and Jushi was lifted; but Dou Gu's request for more troops to continue the pursuit was not granted, the army was called home because the grain would not carry it and the horses were worn out in the cold, so this was a tactical victory rather than a strategic one, and the strength of the Northern Xiongnu was not destroyed in that year. The real conclusion came three years later: in 75 Chelilu Wang led his people west, and the court re-established the Protectorate of the Western Regions, so that the line of garrison colonies and command posts from Yiwulu through Jushi, Liuzhong and Pulei was settled and the objectives set in 73 were at last achieved; in 89, the first year of Yongyuan, Dou Gu, Geng Bing and Wu Tang attacked in several columns, beat the Northern Xiongnu twice at Jiluoshan and at Ranluan Hill, pursued them to the Lake of Siqubidi, and Dou Gu carved the record on the Yanran mountains, writing the break-up of the Northern Xiongnu into stone. Looked at again, the campaign runs on two clear logics: the Han bought security and a corridor in the eastern west with a limited commitment of troops, fighting sharply but not lavishly, while the Xiongnu used a dependent state as an accomplice and the speed of their horse to hold the Han at bay, yet lost the contest of endurance in the frontal clash and could only go west. What decided the field was the pairing of the crossbow line with the cavalry, the pincer of insider and outside force, and two utterly unromantic things: water and grass.
